description:
Creates a webhook. The URL is checked: https:// or http:// to a private LAN address, no user info, and its host must resolve and must not be an address outbound requests may not reach (for a host that is written as a name, every address it resolves to). The answer holds the signing secret once. Errors carry an error.<code> message id: webhook-name-taken, webhook-url-invalid, webhook-url-scheme, webhook-url-userinfo, webhook-url-required, webhook-host-unresolved, webhook-host-lookup-failed (a name lookup failed for now: try again), webhook-host-blocked (the host is, or resolves to, an address webhooks may not reach) and notify-event-not-for-webhook.

Needs: an administrator (a token needs its Administrator switch)

url.description: The receiver's address: https:// to any public host, or http:// to a private LAN address only. No user name or password. It is stored sealed and never returned

events.description: Event ids as in GET /notifications/events (an event a webhook can carry), or ["*"] for every event, also the ones added later. notification.test is never selected by "*".

enabled.description: Whether events are sent to the webhook. Default true

verify_tls.description: Whether the receiver's TLS certificate is verified (https only). Default true

201.description: The webhook with its secret, shown once
